name: Sequential
description: Traditional admin/worker/reviewer pipeline. An admin plans and coordinates, workers execute tasks, and reviewers verify the output.
bus_flow: task → admin → task → workers → log → reviewer → response

roles.name: Admin
roles.description: Plans tasks, coordinates work, monitors progress
roles.system_prompt_suffix: You are the admin agent. Break down tasks, assign work to other agents via the 'task' channel, and monitor progress on the 'log' channel.

roles.name: Worker
roles.description: Executes tasks using tools, reports results
roles.system_prompt_suffix: You are a worker agent. Execute tasks received on the 'task' channel. Report progress and results to the 'log' channel via send_message.

roles.name: Reviewer
roles.description: Reviews work for correctness and quality
roles.system_prompt_suffix: You are a reviewer agent. Review work submitted to the 'review' channel. Check for correctness, completeness, and quality.
